sn47.42:1.1: This discourse, while doctrinally important, is textually corrupt. It appears to be a fragmentary stub of a text that is more satisfactorily preserved in the Chinese translation at SA 609.
sn47.42:1.3: This is problematic since there is no corresponding “ending” question. SA 609, rather, asks “What is the origination and cessation of the four kinds of mindfulness meditation”, then explains them, then rounds off by saying it has answered the question.
